scripts.build: npm run clean && node scripts/brojs.mjs build --dev
scripts.build:prod: npm run contracts:build && npm run clean && node scripts/brojs.mjs build && node scripts/release/assemble.mjs
scripts.build:release: npm run nanos:prepare -- --require-all && npm run build:prod -- --require-all
scripts.compile: npm run contracts:build && node scripts/brojs.mjs compile && node scripts/release/assemble.mjs --out dist/spa
scripts.prom: npm run compile && node scripts/brojs.mjs prom-server --port=8099
scripts.test: node scripts/clean.cjs tests && tsc -p tsconfig.tests.json && node --test .test-dist/tests
scripts.eslint: eslint src packages server tests config scripts bro.config.js eslint.config.mjs --max-warnings=0
scripts.eslint:fix: eslint src packages server tests config scripts bro.config.js eslint.config.mjs --fix --max-warnings=0
scripts.check: npm run contracts:build && npm run format:check && npm run typecheck && npm run lint && npm run test:all
